about: Misthalin piece 7 step 5: the farms and roads between Lumbridge, Draynor and Varrock that no other file has. The cow fields north-west of Lumbridge by the river and north of Fred's farm (53 cows, 16 calves), the River Lum's ducks and drakes north of the cow field (41, swimming), the chickens of the farm south of the Champions' Guild and of the coop north of Groats' farm (19), the level 2 goblins of the fields between Lumbridge and Draynor and north of Lumbridge (53) and a giant spider, two Farmers who tend the fields (no options), the Master Farmer south of Varrock, three crows, two swans on the pond and three imps, the sheep pen south of Varrock (10 sheep, 3 rams; the three mejrs saw shorn are spawned unshorn, inferred), the gardeners Dreven, Vasquen, Fayeth and Treznor with a Tool Leprechaun by each of their patches and one by Draynor Manor's belladonna patch, Tarquin at the canoe station, Seth Groats, and on the Lumbridge to Varrock road Rat Burgiss, two unicorns, a black bear and a level 5 goblin. Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live), checked against every other spawn file (none within 4 tiles of the same NPC) and the 242 map (every swimmer on water, every walker on land). Every wander range is guessed until recorded (5 for animals, 2 or 3 for people, 35 for the river ducks as Lumbridge's). Left out: the Evil Chicken (a random event), and stray sightings for the 12a sweep (a dwarf and a H.A.M. Member north of Lumbridge, Ali the Leaflet Dropper, Avan, Katrine, Sarah, Julie and Guidor by Varrock). What the talking ones say is in content/FarmsRoads.kt.
